periods.summary: Aria fires colored smoke rounds and Kinji calls Nemo, warning the submarines of Moriarty/Livia's ambush.
periods.cause: Radio silence and N's planned surprise attack require optical contact.
periods.process: Kinji and Aria fight through Livia's attacks to reach the submarines' forward line and send smoke signals.
periods.outcome: Nautilus/I-U acknowledge and enter Suez on alert, nullifying the surprise ambush.
periods.significance: First tactical victory of the volume and failure of N's Suez trap.
